content.text: Home > Sustainability Sustainability at SABIC At SABIC, we believe that business plays a vital role in developing solutions to address the significant challenges we all face. As a company we’re integrating sustainability into the way we think and act. Understanding the scale and urgency of this challenge, we are also committed to collaborating with our stakeholders and business partners across the value chain to develop innovative sustainability solutions for the industries and regions in which we operate. Our Vision We will integrate environmental, social, and economic dimensions of sustainability into our core business operations and growth strategy to ensure we are well-positioned to make the greatest difference for our customers and the communities we serve. As one of the world’s largest petrochemical manufacturers, we are uniquely positioned in the value chain to deliver new, sustainable solutions to the end markets we serve – construction, medical devices, packaging, agri-nutrients, electronics, transportation, and clean energy. At the same time, we understand the importance of reducing our emissions and accelerating our contributions to the circular carbon economy using collaborative approaches that deliver groundbreaking solutions. Chemistry That Shapes Tomorrow With sustainability and innovation at the core of our strategy, we continue to focus our people and resources on solutions that will make the greatest difference. Climate Change In line with the Paris Agreement, we have committed to decarbonizing our operations by 2050*. We aim to reduce our (Scope 1 & 2) greenhouse gas emissions by 2030 by 20% compared to 2018 levels and to collaborate with our partners in initiatives focussed on reducing our indirect Scope 3 emissions along the value chain. Climate, Energy & Resource Efficiency SUSTAINABLE SOLUTIONS Circular Economy We are powering our innovations and sustainable solutions and working with upstream and downstream partners to advance a circular economy. Initiatives include TRUCIRCLE™, our portfolio of solutions to accelerate a circular economy for plastics. Circular Economy Sustainable Solutions Learn More * SABIC has committed to the Paris Agreement goals and will continually pursue efforts and explore solutions to meet carbon neutrality from operations under its control by 2050, taking into account the different regional and national ambitions, commitments and initiatives.
